articles.title: LLMs respond differently to harmful prompts when AI watermarking is used
articles.content: SynthID can cause models to follow harmful instructions they would otherwise refuse.
articles.titleZh: 使用AI水印时， LLM对有害提示的反应不同
articles.contentZh: SynthID可能会导致模型遵循否则会拒绝的有害指令。

articles.title: Nonprofit that tracks meteors taken down by "critical blow" from a cyberattack
articles.content: Group plans to be largely out of commission for several weeks.

articles.title: ClickFix attacks infecting PCs and Macs are going viral
articles.content: Simplicity—combined with the difficulty of getting stuff done—makes ClickFix ideal.
articles.titleZh: 感染PC和Mac的ClickFix攻击正在病毒式传播
articles.contentZh: 简单-结合完成工作的难度-使ClickFix成为理想选择。

articles.title: Waymo says Singapore will be its next international robotaxi city
articles.content: Waymo says it will launch a robotaxi service in Singapore in 2028, as the Alphabet-owned company continues to eye overseas markets for expansion. Waymo's vehicles will begin arriving in Singapore in "the coming months," the company says, in preparation of mapping and autonomous testing with human safety drivers behind the wheel in 2027. articles.title: The AI Superintelligence Slowdown
articles.content: Remember when tech leaders would tell their employees to “move fast and break things”? It seemed that would be the way of AI too. But after a summer where rogue AI agents became reality, and researchers warned that AI could kill us all, a number of leading US AI companies are publicly suggesting it’s time […]
